why: No major reviewer or authority appears at all. Only one niche page (roxskin) names an under-$150 pick, and it says outright it hasn't tested devices; two others are documentation rewrites of a single $80 watch. The rest are HYROX-community listicles whose budget picks are $200–$250 Coros/Garmin watches without a race mode, three results are unreadable, and the one hands-on piece is a recycled article that ignores the price band. A focused page comparing the few sub-$150 race-mode watches with current prices would stand out.
